description: The prose slots of a story. prose.json carries exactly these keys; the renderer validates each against its bound and renders an unwritten block for any slot that is missing, empty, or over its bound. Per-beat slots are keyed by the beat's citation.

thin.description: When a chapter has no beats, its slots are not written by the model; the renderer uses these fixed sentences.

steering.en: The record holds no steer after the spark.
steering.nl: Het verslag bevat geen bijsturing na de vonk.

judgment.en: The record holds no moment where you overruled Claude.
judgment.nl: Het verslag bevat geen moment waarop je Claude overstemde.
